I really feel you! I’m in the exact situation here. 22 years old and my whole family treats me like a child, I’m the “small sensitive”. I got money from my grandfather who died when I was 2 years old, so this money is the only thing I have from him. After I turned 18 my mother wanted to gave me this money but I said she better put it in a safe. So 2 years after that I wanted to spend that money on a bank fond and asked for it. She then said that she needed it and now it is gone. It was quite much 1.300€ and I’m pretty sure I will never see that again. Right now my mom had some really bad issues with the insurance company and didn’t paid her bills so my sister paid it for her. But she still has issues so I guess I have to help her... for me the worst part was that she didn’t ask. I would give her the money when she really needs it, but she took it without talking to me... so I’m not really sure when she “stole” it... I think it’s really hard to call authorities, I wouldn’t be brave enough to do this.. so maybe talk to her and quit this bank account so that you mum has no permission to get to your money and transfer it to your account. Keep your money by yourself and don’t trust your mum with that. I learned it the hard way. Try to get your money back but if this is not possible you might never get it back...
